prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single definitive “best” lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the injuries, the insurance issues, and what kind of lawyer you want (settlement-focused vs trial-ready). I can help you find one, but first here are practical steps and criteria to identify the best personal injury lawyer for your situation in Houston.

Key things to look for
- Board certification: Texas Board of Legal Specialization certifies “Personal Injury Trial” lawyers — that’s a strong indicator of skill and experience.  
- Trial experience: Many insurers settle, but you want a lawyer who will take your case to trial if needed. Ask how many jury trials they’ve handled.  
- Track record: Look for past verdicts/settlements and cases similar to yours (car wrecks, comparable injuries). Big results don’t guarantee success in every case, but they show capability.  
- Local experience: A lawyer familiar with Harris County courts, judges and local insurers is an advantage.  
- Reputation & peer review: AV Preeminent (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers, or membership in Million Dollar Advocates can be useful signals.  
- Communication & team: Who will handle the case day-to-day? Will you get regular updates?  
- Fees & expenses: Typical arrangement is contingency (no recovery, no fee). Ask the percentage and who advances costs.  
- Client reviews: Google, Yelp and local referrals can reveal how responsive and ethical a firm is.

Where to search
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization (search board-certified personal injury trial lawyers in Harris County)  
- SuperLawyers.com (Houston personal injury section)  
- Martindale-Hubbell directory and AV ratings  
- Local bar association referral (Harris County Bar)  
- Google Maps / reviews for local firms

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- Have you handled many car-accident cases like mine? What were the results?  
- Do you have trial experience in Harris County? How many jury trials?  
- Who in your firm will handle my case? Will I deal directly with the attorney?  
- What is your contingency fee and what costs would I be responsible for?  
- What is your estimate of my case’s value and timeline?  
- How will you communicate with me and how often?

If you want, I can:
- Narrow recommendations if you tell me your ZIP code/neighborhood, injury severity, whether the crash involves complicated issues (e.g., uninsured motorist, commercial vehicle, drunk driver), or language preferences.  
- Provide sample scripts or an email you can use to contact firms for a consultation.

Tell me a little about your crash (where in Houston, injuries, at-fault/insurance situation) and I’ll help you narrow the list and suggest lawyers to contact.
